input_contract.assembly: human reference genome; exact GRCh38 provenance not independently verified

score_contract.score_semantics: masked-language-model logits/embeddings; no official raw SNV VEP contract verified

provenance.notes: Official repository and checkpoint were audited and the pinned checkpoint passed a bounded real H100 checkpoint/embedding/logit smoke on a synthetic one-base pair. Caduceus-Ph is a 131,072-bp masked-language model trained with reverse-complement augmentation; its documented downstream procedure runs sequence and reverse complement, but no raw allele-effect VEP API was verified. A pseudo-likelihood adapter would not be apples-to-apples with Evo2 without a predeclared protocol. This is SUBSET_ONLY for embeddings/logits, not included in the raw-score benchmark. Evidence: artifacts/model_audit/phase5_real_smokes_20260921.json.
